title: Disable weight decay
description: Changed WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.0 (Muon cautious weight decay), everything else at baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8)
reflection: val_bpb 0.985242, worse than baseline 0.982558 (~0.27% regression). Weight decay is not merely fighting the optimizer in this short budget -- it's doing real regularization work even at 5 minutes. This closes the low end of the WEIGHT_DECAY sweep; combined with a1's 0.05 and a2's 0.1 runs this round, we should get a full bracket (0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2-baseline) to see whether the optimum is below 0.2 or whether 0.2 itself is already good.
